## Specific Concerns

What specific aspects would you like feedback on?

- [ ] Aesthetic direction & anti-default test
- [ ] Token system completeness
- [ ] Layout & component states
- [ ] Motion choreography
- [ ] Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- [ ] Performance budgets
- [ ] Cross-browser/device consistency
- [ ] Content strategy

## Verification Status

- [ ] Pre-flight checklist run
- [ ] Automated a11y sweep (axe/Lighthouse) clean
- [ ] Keyboard-only pass complete
- [ ] 200% zoom / 320px reflow verified
- [ ] Reduced-motion pass verified
- [ ] Contrast measured in both themes
- [ ] Lighthouse scores observed (not asserted)
